---
title: "Brand guide"
subtitle: "Colors, type, logos and chart colors, read from the theme"
toc: true
---

Everything on this page comes from `brand.yml`. The swatches are drawn from the `--brand-*` CSS variables Quarto generates from the palette, so they cannot drift from the real values. Switch the page to dark mode with the toggle in the navbar to see the dark roles.

## Color roles

These are the semantic colors in `brand.yml` (`color.primary`, `color.background` and the rest). Each has a light and a dark value, which Quarto (Bootstrap, slides, Typst) reads. Shiny and the R and Python brand.yml packages read `brand-flat.yml`, the same brand with light values only.

```{=html}
<div class="bg-roles" id="bg-roles"></div>
```

## Palette

Every named color in `color.palette`, grouped by what it is for. Names are the Sass variable (`$brand-wfrc-navy`) and the CSS variable (`var(--brand-wfrc-navy)`). The theme SCSS maps *roles* onto these names and never writes a hex code of its own.

```{=html}
<div id="bg-palette"></div>
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Contrast
Bright blue (`wfrc-bright-blue`) is 3.5:1 on white: use it for rules, focus rings and large fills only. Buttons and interactive fills use `wfrc-action` (5.0:1). Brick (`wfrc-brick`) is 4.5:1, so a brick fill that carries small white text uses `wfrc-brick-deep` (5.5:1).
:::

## Type

```{=html}
<div class="bg-type">
  <div><span class="bg-label">Headings: Inter 700</span><p class="bg-h1">Planning the Wasatch Front</p></div>
  <div><span class="bg-label">Body: Poppins 400 at 16px, line height 1.6</span><p>Population grew 2.1% last year, and jobs grew faster than housing across the four counties.</p></div>
  <div><span class="bg-label">Code: Fira Code 400</span><p><code>pti = tt_95 / tt_ff</code></p></div>
</div>
```

Fonts load from Google Fonts by default. To bundle them instead, point `project.brand` at `_extensions/wfrc-brand/brand-offline.yml`.

## Logos

`brand.yml` ships three logo shapes in color and white. Quarto picks the color version on light pages and the white one on dark pages (`logo.small`, `medium` and `large` have `light` and `dark` values), and every logo carries alt text.

```{=html}
<div class="bg-logos">
  <figure><div class="bg-chip"><img src="_extensions/wfrc-brand/assets/logo/horizontal/WFRC_logo_horizontal_color_transparent.png" alt="Wasatch Front Regional Council"></div><figcaption><code>large</code>: horizontal</figcaption></figure>
  <figure><div class="bg-chip"><img src="_extensions/wfrc-brand/assets/logo/stacked/WFRC_logo_stacked_color_transparent.png" alt="Wasatch Front Regional Council"></div><figcaption><code>medium</code>: stacked</figcaption></figure>
  <figure><div class="bg-chip"><img src="_extensions/wfrc-brand/assets/logo/abbreviated/WFRC_logo_abbreviated_color_transparent.png" alt="Wasatch Front Regional Council"></div><figcaption><code>small</code>: abbreviated</figcaption></figure>
  <figure><div class="bg-chip bg-chip-dark"><img src="_extensions/wfrc-brand/assets/logo/horizontal/WFRC_logo_horizontal_white_transparent.png" alt="Wasatch Front Regional Council"></div><figcaption>white, for dark surfaces</figcaption></figure>
</div>
```

Do not recolor, stretch or add effects to the logo, and keep clear space around it equal to the height of the "W".

## Chart colors

Five categorical colors in a fixed order. They pass lightness, chroma and color-vision checks. Never cycle past five: facet, or group the rest as "Other". Gold is below 3:1 on white, so label series directly instead of relying on a legend.

```{=html}
<div class="bg-charts" id="bg-charts"></div>
```

The helpers read these from `brand.yml`: `wfrc-charts.R` (ggplot2), `wfrc_charts.py` (matplotlib, plotly) and `wfrc-charts.js` (Observable Plot). See the [components example](example.qmd) for each in use.

## Use it in your own project

| Where | How |
|---|---|
| Quarto site | `project.brand: _extensions/wfrc-brand/brand.yml`, then `$brand-wfrc-navy` in SCSS and `var(--brand-wfrc-navy)` in CSS |
| Slides, PDF | `format: wfrc-brand-revealjs` or `wfrc-brand-typst` |
| Shiny (R) | `bs_theme(brand = "_extensions/wfrc-brand/brand-flat.yml")` |
| Shiny (Python) | `ui.Theme.from_brand("_extensions/wfrc-brand/brand-flat.yml")` |
| Charts | the helpers above |

```{=html}
<style>
.bg-roles, #bg-palette, .bg-charts { margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem; }
.bg-group { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.bg-group h3 { margin: 0 0 0.6rem; font-size: 1.05rem; border: 0; }
.bg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; }
.bg-sw { border: 1px solid var(--wfrc-line); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--wfrc-surface); font-size: 0.78rem; }
.bg-sw .bg-fill { height: 56px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wfrc-line); }
.bg-sw .bg-meta { padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.bg-sw .bg-meta strong { display: block; font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.bg-sw .bg-meta span { color: var(--wfrc-ink-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.bg-type > div { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.bg-label { display: block; font: 600 0.72rem/1.4 "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--wfrc-ink-2); }
.bg-h1 { font: 700 2rem/1.15 "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--wfrc-h1); margin: 0.2rem 0 0; }
.bg-logos { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
.bg-logos figure { margin: 0; }
.bg-logos figcaption { font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; color: var(--wfrc-ink-2); }
.bg-chip { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--wfrc-line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 120px; }
.bg-chip img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 90px; }
.bg-chip-dark { background: #00395b; }
</style>
<script>
function drawBrandGuide() {
  // Collect every --brand-* custom property the theme defines, then draw swatches from them.
  var vars = {};
  function scan(rules) {
    for (var i = 0; i < rules.length; i++) {
      var r = rules[i];
      if (r.cssRules && !r.selectorText) scan(r.cssRules);
      if (r.style && r.selectorText && /(^|,)\s*(:root|body|html)\b/.test(r.selectorText)) {
        for (var j = 0; j < r.style.length; j++) {
          var n = r.style[j];
          if (n.indexOf('--brand-') === 0) vars[n.slice(8)] = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.styleSheets, function (s) { try { scan(s.cssRules); } catch (e) {} });
  var cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  function swVar(cssVar, label) {
    var h = cs.getPropertyValue(cssVar).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!h) return '';
    return '<div class="bg-sw"><div class="bg-fill" style="background:var(' + cssVar + ')"></div><div class="bg-meta"><strong>' + label + '</strong><span>' + h + '</span></div></div>';
  }
  function sw(name, label) { return swVar('--brand-' + name, label || name); }
  function group(title, names, labeller) {
    var cells = names.map(function (n) { return sw(n, labeller && labeller(n)); }).join('');
    return cells ? '<div class="bg-group"><h3>' + title + '</h3><div class="bg-grid">' + cells + '</div></div>' : '';
  }
  var all = Object.keys(vars);
  var groups = [
    ['Core brand', function (n) { return /^wfrc-(navy|mid-blue|bright-blue|action|brick|brick-deep|gold|gray|taupe)$/.test(n); }],
    ['Light surfaces and ink', function (n) { return /^wfrc-(paper|band|mist|card|hairline|code|ink|ink-soft)$/.test(n); }],
    ['Dark surfaces and ink', function (n) { return /^wfrc-(night|snow)/.test(n); }],
    ['Dark-mode tints', function (n) { return /^wfrc-(sky|ice|brick-light|brick-bright)/.test(n); }],
    ['Callouts', function (n) { return /^wfrc-(note|tip|warning-bar|caution)/.test(n); }],
    ['Categorical chart colors', function (n) { return /^chart-/.test(n); }],
    ['Regional Transportation Plan maps', function (n) { return /^rtp-/.test(n); }],
    ['Wasatch Choice maps', function (n) { return /^wc-/.test(n); }],
    ['Unified Plan maps', function (n) { return /^up-/.test(n); }],
    ['Bootstrap color names', function (n) { return /^(blue|indigo|purple|pink|red|orange|yellow|green|teal|cyan|white|black)$/.test(n); }]
  ];
  var used = {}, html = '';
  groups.forEach(function (g) {
    var names = all.filter(function (n) { return g[1](n) && !used[n]; });
    names.forEach(function (n) { used[n] = 1; });
    html += group(g[0], names.sort());
  });
  var rest = all.filter(function (n) { return !used[n]; }).sort();
  html += group('Other', rest);
  document.getElementById('bg-palette').innerHTML = html;

  // Quarto turns color.primary and the other roles into Bootstrap variables.
  var roles = [['Primary', '--bs-primary'], ['Secondary', '--bs-secondary'], ['Background', '--bs-body-bg'], ['Foreground', '--bs-body-color'], ['Success', '--bs-success'], ['Info', '--bs-info'], ['Warning', '--bs-warning'], ['Danger', '--bs-danger']];
  document.getElementById('bg-roles').innerHTML = '<div class="bg-grid">' + roles.map(function (r) { return swVar(r[1], r[0]); }).join('') + '</div>';

  var order = ['chart-1', 'chart-2', 'chart-3', 'chart-4', 'chart-5'];
  var dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('quarto-dark') || (document.body && document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark'));
  document.getElementById('bg-charts').innerHTML = '<div class="bg-grid">' + order.map(function (n, i) {
    return sw(dark && vars[n + '-dark'] ? n + '-dark' : n, 'Series ' + (i + 1));
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}
drawBrandGuide();
// The color-scheme toggle swaps stylesheets, so redraw the swatches after it is used.
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.quarto-color-scheme-toggle')) setTimeout(drawBrandGuide, 300);
});
</script>
```
